tools.name: localstack-aws-client
tools.description: Executes an AWS CLI command against the running LocalStack container using the 'awslocal' wrapper.

command.description: The AWS CLI command to execute (e.g., 's3 ls', 'dynamodb list-tables'). Do not include 'awslocal' or 'aws'.

tools.name: localstack-chaos-injector
tools.description: Injects, manages, and clears chaos faults and network effects in LocalStack to test system resilience.

action.description: The specific chaos engineering action to perform.

service.description: Name of the AWS service to affect (e.g., 's3', 'lambda').

region.description: Name of the AWS region to affect (e.g., 'us-east-1').

operation.description: Name of the specific service operation to affect (e.g., 'CreateBucket').

probability.description: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) of the fault occurring.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code to return (e.g., 503).

code.description: The AWS error code to return (e.g., 'ServiceUnavailable').

items.description: A single rule defining a chaos fault.

rules.description: An array of fault rules. Required for 'inject-faults', 'add-fault-rule', and 'remove-fault-rule' actions.

latency_ms.description: Network latency in milliseconds. Required for the 'inject-latency' action.

tools.name: localstack-cloud-pods
tools.description: Manages LocalStack Cloud Pods with following actions: save, load, delete, reset

action.description: The Cloud Pods action to perform.

pod_name.description: The name of the Cloud Pod. This is required for 'save', 'load', and 'delete' actions.

tools.name: localstack-deployer
tools.description: Deploys or destroys AWS infrastructure on LocalStack using CDK or Terraform.

action.description: The action to perform: 'deploy'/'destroy' for CDK/Terraform, or 'create-stack'/'delete-stack' for CloudFormation.

projectType.description: The type of project. 'auto' (default) infers from files. Specify 'cdk' or 'terraform' to override.

directory.description: The required path to the project directory containing your infrastructure-as-code files.

variables.description: Key-value pairs for parameterization. Used for Terraform variables (-var) or CDK context (-c).

stackName.description: The name of the CloudFormation stack. Required for 'create-stack' and 'delete-stack'.

templatePath.description: The local file path to the CloudFormation template. Required for 'create-stack' if not discoverable from 'directory'.

tools.name: localstack-iam-policy-analyzer
tools.description: Configures LocalStack's IAM enforcement and analyzes logs to automatically generate missing IAM policies.

action.description: The action to perform: 'set-mode' to configure enforcement, 'analyze-policies' to generate a policy from logs, or 'get-status' to check the current mode.

mode.description: The enforcement mode to set. This is required only when the action is 'set-mode'.

tools.name: localstack-logs-analysis
tools.description: LocalStack log analyzer that helps developers quickly diagnose issues and understand their LocalStack interactions

analysisType.description: The analysis to perform: 'summary' (default), 'errors', 'requests', or 'logs' for raw output.

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch and analyze.

service.description: Filter by AWS service (e.g., 's3', 'lambda'). Used with 'errors' and 'requests' modes.

operation.description: Filter by a specific API operation (e.g., 'CreateBucket'). Requires 'service'. Used with 'requests' mode.

filter.description: Raw keyword filter. Only used with 'logs' mode.

tools.name: localstack-management
tools.description: Manage LocalStack lifecycle: start, stop, restart, or check status

action.description: The LocalStack management action to perform

envVars.description: Additional environment variables as key-value pairs (only for start action)
